title: Aliens in Ladakh? The Truth About Kongka La Pass
tags: unsolved mystery of kongka la pass
description:
What if India had its own Area 51? Conspiracy theorists claim that UFOs frequently land at Kongka La Pass, a remote region in the Himalayas between Ladakh and Aksai Chin. From alleged underground alien bases to Google Earth images showing mysterious structures, this place has become the center of UFO myths.

We explore the 1959 clash between Indian and Chinese troops that put Kongka La in the spotlight, reports of glowing objects and saucer-shaped crafts, and why locals believe the region is haunted by soldiers and visited by aliens. From Indian Army sightings near Pangong Lake, to pilgrims claiming triangular flying objects, to conspiracy theories of governments hiding UFO bases — the stories are endless.

But what does the science say? We explain close encounters of the first, second, and third kind, the psychology of UFO sightings, logical fallacies like the argument from personal incredulity, and why amateur astronomers never confirm these so-called alien crafts. We also look at the real possibility of alien life using Drake’s equation, habitable zones, Europa’s ocean, and the vast distances of galaxies that make alien visits unlikely.

If you’ve searched for “Kongka La UFO sightings,” “India’s Area 51,” “UFO base Ladakh,” “aliens in Himalayas,” or “Kongka La conspiracy”, this video gives you the rational perspective. Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share…
